page_title: ARG 2-0 MEX | Argentina v Mexico 26/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Daniele Orsato is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90+5' Uriel Antuna (Mexico) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+5' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90+4' Daniele Orsato has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lionel Messi (Argentina).
90+1' Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Hector Moreno (Mexico) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) is cautioned by the referee.

87' 2 - 0 Goal! Lionel Messi plays in Enzo Fernandez (Argentina), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 2:0.
87' Argentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

87' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Argentina have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Luis Chavez (Mexico) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
85' A spell of possession for Mexico in an attempt to control the game.
81' Exequiel Palacios (Argentina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement.
80' The attendance is 88966.
79' Hector Herrera (Mexico) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
75' Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
74' Luis Chavez (Mexico) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Orsato saw the whole situation.
73' The game has come to an end for Hirving Lozano. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Roberto Alvarado (Mexico).
71' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
70' Nahuel Molina (Argentina) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
69' Lionel Scaloni has decided to make a change. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) replaces Angel Di Maria.
69' Exequiel Palacios (Argentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
69' Uriel Antuna (Mexico) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
66' Hector Herrera (Mexico) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
66' Here is a change. Kevin Alvarez is going off and Gerardo Martino gives the last tactical orders to Raul Jimenez (Mexico).
66' Substitution. Alexis Vega leaves the pitch and is replaced by Uriel Antuna (Mexico).

64' 1 - 0 Angel Di Maria passes to Lionel Messi (Argentina), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:0.
64' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Argentina.
63' Lionel Scaloni decides to make a substitution. Gonzalo Montiel will be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Argentina).
63' Substitution. Julian Alvarez (Argentina) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
62' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
60' Alexis Vega (Mexico) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
59' Rough tackle by Lisandro Martinez (Argentina). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Guido Rodriguez departs the field of play to be replaced by Enzo Fernandez (Argentina).
57' Lionel Messi (Argentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
56' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' 8:12 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
54' Daniele Orsato blows for a foul after Lionel Messi (Argentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
52' Flag goes up against Alexis Vega (Mexico) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Lionel Messi (Argentina) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
50' Argentina are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
50' Erick Gutierrez (Mexico) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Orsato and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) unleashes a shot from distance but his effort is well blocked.
47' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina).
46' Nestor Araujo (Mexico) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Lionel Messi (Argentina) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

45+6' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. Argentina win a corner kick.
45+5' Alexis Vega (Mexico) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alexis Vega (Mexico) heads on.
45+2' Lionel Messi (Argentina) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alexis Vega (Mexico) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Emiliano Martinez to dive and make a save.
43' Mexico win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
43' Daniele Orsato shows a yellow card to Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) for his blatant foul.
42' Gerardo Martino is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Andres Guardado (Mexico) suffers an injury and Erick Gutierrez comes on.
41' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
41' Argentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Argentina have a corner.
39' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
38' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
36' The referee blows his whistle as Hirving Lozano (Mexico) was too aggressive in his challenge.
34' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle as Lisandro Martinez (Argentina) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
34' Lionel Messi (Argentina) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Guillermo Ochoa to dive and make a save.
33' Alexis Vega (Mexico) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Argentina.
32' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lionel Messi (Argentina) is cleared to safety by the defence.
32' Daniele Orsato couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Hector Herrera (Mexico) and blew his whistle.
31' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Orsato stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
31' The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
30' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) is caught offside!
28' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Orsato no option but to blow his whistle.
26' Kevin Alvarez (Mexico) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
25' Flag up against Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
22' Nestor Araujo (Mexico) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
20' Referee Daniele Orsato sees the trip by Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
18' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) is adjudged offside.
16' Hector Herrera (Mexico) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' The players claim that Andres Guardado (Mexico) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
11' Luis Chavez (Mexico) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Orsato interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' What an opportunity! Cesar Montes (Mexico) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
9' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Orsato blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Mexico.
8' Alexis Vega (Mexico) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
8' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mexico are going to take it.
8' Alexis Vega (Mexico) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
7' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
5' Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
5' Alexis Vega (Mexico) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
3' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
2' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle after Andres Guardado (Mexico) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
